usage: The word 實驗 is used as a noun to describe a scientific test or procedure performed to discover or prove something.
You can use 實驗 to refer to experiments in various fields, not only in science but also in social studies or product testing.
In sentences, 實驗 typically acts as the subject or object. For example, you can say “我做咗個實驗” (I did an experiment).
It can be combined with verbs like 做 (to do), 進行 (to conduct), or 失敗 (to fail) to discuss actions related to an experiment.
實驗 is always countable, so you might see it paired with measure words like 個 (go3) or 次 (ci3).
